Sabbath Service Desk — FluidSynth hymn music engine (optional)
==============================================================

1. FluidSynth 2.6.2
   Copyright (C) 2000-2026 Peter Hanappe and others.
   Licence: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later
   (LICENSE-FluidSynth-LGPL-2.1 in this folder).
   This folder holds an unmodified FluidSynth 2.6.2 compiled to WebAssembly:
     fluidsynth-2.6.2.mjs
     SHA256 2b4b3242678c5b4d6f615ded08f114bb0a55cf54032ba9ab1dfda8ed2a4de882
   Corresponding source:
     - FluidSynth 2.6.2, official release https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth/releases/tag/v2.6.2
       (tarball SHA256 ca376b42a3c1b186a4c8c248931789a455ac94a89b777394969d678010c2f91f)
     - src/ssdesk_fluidsynth_api.c (the small C wrapper), src/pthread_setschedparam_stub.c and
       src/build-emscripten.sh (the exact Emscripten build), in this folder and in the
       repository https://github.com/LeeMcQ/SDA_Sabbath (vendor/fluidsynth/src/).
   You may rebuild fluidsynth-2.6.2.mjs from that source and replace the file.
   FluidSynth itself was not modified. Sabbath Service Desk's own code calls it only
   through the wrapper above and stays under its own licence.

2. Fluid R3 General MIDI SoundFont (data/music/FluidR3_GM.sf2.part1 + .part2)
   Copyright 2000-2002, 2008 Frank Wen; 2008 Toby Smithe (Debian packaging).
   Licence: MIT (data/music/FluidR3_GM-LICENSE.txt). Source: Debian fluid-soundfont-gm 3.1-5.3.
   The file is stored in two parts because of a file-size limit; joined they are the original
   FluidR3_GM.sf2, 148,398,306 bytes, SHA256
   74594e8f4250680adf590507a306655a299935343583256f3b722c48a1bc1cb0

3. GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 (data/music/GeneralUser-GS.sf2)
   Copyright S. Christian Collins. Licence: the author's License v2.0
   (data/music/GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt). https://www.schristiancollins.com/generaluser
   SHA256 9575028c7a1f589f5770fccc8cff2734566af40cd26ed836944e9a5152688cfe
